title: Vocal Music under Phoneme-Conditional Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.30823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The vocal music of each language carries a distinctive sonic identity, even without instrumental accompaniment. We ask whether these differences are measurable and traceable to specific phonemes. To tackle this question, we introduce phoneme-conditional analysis, which isolates the acoustic effect of typologically distinctive phonemes by comparing marker syllables against matched non-marker controls within the same song, holding singer, melody, and genre constant. Across nine typologically diverse languages and thousands of songs, we measure effects along five acoustic dimensions. Song-level profiles built from these effects identify the language of an unaccompanied vocal at 85.5% balanced accuracy in a nine-way classification with folds grouped by artist; whether the separability arises by accumulation of the phoneme-local effects themselves is left open. translated_title: 音素条件分析下的声乐研究
translated_abstract: 每种语言的声乐即使在没有乐器伴奏的情况下，也带有独特的声音特征。我们探究这些差异是否可测量，以及能否追溯到特定的音素。为解决这一问题，我们提出了音素条件分析，该方法通过在同一首歌曲内将标记音节与匹配的非标记对照音节进行比较，来分离类型学上独特音素的声学效应，同时保持歌手、旋律和体裁不变。在九种类型学上多样的语言和数千首歌曲中，我们沿五个声学维度测量了这些效应。基于这些效应构建的歌曲级特征，在以艺术家分组的九分类任务中，能以85.5%的平衡准确率识别出无伴奏人声的语言；这种可分性是否源于音素局部效应本身的累积，仍有待探讨。我们的研究结果表明，音系结构会在声乐演唱上留下系统性的、可测量的……
tldr: 该论文提出音素条件分析方法，通过在同一歌曲内对比标记音节与匹配对照来分离特定音素的声学效应，并证明基于这些效应的歌曲级特征能以85.5%的平衡准确率识别九种语言的无伴奏人声。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces phoneme-conditional analysis, which isolates the acoustic effects of typologically distinctive phonemes within the same song, and shows that song-level profiles built from these effects classify the language of unaccompanied vocals across nine languages at 85.5% balanced accuracy.
